ios.desc:
Celebrate Life, One Day at a Time

Discover a new perspective on life with Days of Life and celebrate more special days than just your birthday! Track the number of days you’ve lived, get notified about milestones in your life and those of your friends and family, celebrate days beyond traditional calendars—all in one beautifully simple app.

TRACK YOUR JOURNEY
See how many days you’ve been alive and mark major milestones like your first 10,000th day, your 22,222th day, or the next 1,000th day.

CELEBRATE WITH FRIENDS AND FAMILY
Add profiles for loved ones and celebrate their milestones too. You can even share a special visual representation of their Days of Life to celebrate the days that truly count.

STAY NOTIFIED
Never miss a milestone with multiple customizable notifications for all of your profiles.

WIDGETS AT A GLANCE
Keep track of your current day or upcoming milestones directly from your Home or Lock Screen.

--------

Days of Life Pro

- Unlimited profiles: add as many profiles as you want to always be up to date with your friends' milestones
- Import contacts: save time by importing all of your contacts with birthdays and keep them in sync with any new ones you add
- Add birth time: get more precise calculations and notifications by adding the time of birth for all profiles

You can buy Days of Life Pro as a one-time in-app purchase within the app.

Support: https://daysoflife.pages.dev
Privacy: https://daysoflife.pages.dev/privacy

quotes.text:
Working on updating my Your-Age-in-Days app[1] for iOS 26. The main motivation was to have the days I've lived always available on the lock screen with a more native feel than the workaround I had before (nightly Shortcut which updates the background image and adds the current number as an overlay to it).

[1]: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/days-of-life-milestones/id6738207784?l=en-GB
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What Are You Working On? (December 2025)

quotes.text:
Was looking for an iOS app to always see my age in days on the lock screen. Didn‘t find one, so I first created a shortcut which would change my lock screen background image each night and overlay the number of days on it.

This didn’t feel integrated enough and could fail if the phone was off, so I started looking into Swift and created my first app [1] with added features like contact import and notifications for other people‘s ages in days.

It‘s still very much a work in progress but the core functionality of the lock screen widget is something I use almost every day to quickly get the current number and use it for notes etc. I just like having an incrementing unique-to-me number to reference stuff.

[1]: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/days-of-life-milestones/id6738207784
